CEL.Title: Aether Ledger
CEL.BadDrop: Drop the right document type here.
CEL.SetFxHint: Canvas shake and particle bursts for ledger events (this client only). Shake is also disabled by Foundry's photosensitive mode.
CEL.SetSoundHint: Coin, thud and fanfare sounds (this client only).
CEL.SetDebugHint: Log each month-close step to the browser console (F12). Useful when reporting a bug.
CEL.SetBannerHint: Optional wide image shown behind the ledger title for everyone. Leave empty for the built-in wood and brass look.
CEL.SetThemeHint: Visual template for the ledger window: colorway, wood, metals and glows.
CEL.SetTplHint: Advanced: path to a replacement Handlebars template (e.g. modules/my-module/ledger-custom.hbs). Copy templates/ledger.hbs from this module as a starting point. Leave empty for the built-in template.
